edges_upsert.note: Married 1859 when she was about five; never consummated; worshipped her as Shodashi 1872; the order counts her his first disciple
Her attendant and guardian for decades; built the Udbodhan house, where she lived from 23 May 1909
Inspired his study of Vedanta while he taught in Lahore (Wikipedia; Divine Life Society)
Vivekananda lectured in Lahore, 9 and 12 November 1897; Tirath Ram helped arrange the visit (gold watch anecdote); Puran Singh treats it as the turn toward renunciation
Met in Tokyo, September 1902; Puran took sannyas under his influence for a time; wrote The Story of Swami Rama (1924)
Ramakrishna Order (joined 1994); Vedanta Society of New York, founded by Vivekananda in 1894, which he has led since January 2017
Teaches Shankara's Advaita from the commentaries

issues: sarada-devi.mdx: death date given as 20 July (Wikipedia) and 21 July 1920 (Sri Sarada Math); both stated. Cause given as malaria (Math) or kala-azar (Wikipedia).
sarada-devi.mdx: Vrindavan samadhi and Ramakrishna's appearance reported as devotees' account; the 'nahabat' and Cossipore nursing details are standard but were not separately fetched.

rama-tirtha.mdx: sannyasa date conflicts (Diwali 1899 Wikipedia; 1900 Tribune; early 1901 Encyclopaedia of Sikhism); all three stated. Mother's death (days old vs about one) and who raised him (brother Gurudas vs paternal aunt) also conflict; stated.

rama-tirtha.mdx: whether his drowning was deliberate is disputed; Encyclopaedia of Sikhism calls it intentional. Place given as near Tehri; Wikipedia body mentions Vasishtha Ashram near Rishikesh. Not resolved.
rama-tirtha.mdx: Puran Singh's dates (1881–1931) in nodes_add are from memory; please verify.

sarvapriyananda.mdx: living person. Birth year 1971 from Wikipedia and The Global Indian; full birth date omitted. Wikipedia says sannyasa was given by Swami Ranganathananda; not included because unconfirmed by the Society.

sarvapriyananda.mdx: includes one sentence, from The Global Indian (Oct 2026), on his 2026 consultation with Anthropic about AI ethics and a short quote. Author may wish to cut it as tangential or for conflict-of-interest reasons, since this draft was produced with an Anthropic model.

parts/neo-vedanta.mdx: characterisations of Radhakrishnan, Chinmayananda, Dayananda (Arsha Vidya) and Acharya Prashant were written before their profiles exist; check against those entries, especially the statement that Arsha Vidya teachers argued against conversion.

sarada-devi: Born 22 Dec 1853, Jayrambati; married at about five; to Dakshineswar at eighteen; died 21 July 1920; last message; Amjad quote; japa 10,000-15,000 -> https://srisaradamath.org/hm.php

Parents Ramachandra Mukhopadhyay and Shyamasundari Devi; 1859; died 20 July 1920; Kamarpukur poverty ~1 year; Calcutta 1888; Nivedita; final message wording -> https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Sarada_Devi
Shodashi Puja 1872 on night of Phalaharini Kali Puja -> https://media.belurmath.org/shodashi-puja-2019-4689/
Moved to Udbodhan 23 May 1909; Mayer Bari -> https://udbodhan.org/timeline/ma-sarada-arrives/
Sri Sarada Math started 2 Dec 1954; Vivekananda quote 'Mother has been born to revive that wonderful Shakti in India' -> https://belurmath.org/womens-monastic-organization/
rama-tirtha: Born 22 Oct 1873 Muraliwala; MA maths Government College Lahore 1895; married at eleven; sannyasa early 1901; Japan; Hillers; Shasta; died 17 Oct 1906 deliberate -> https://eos.learnpunjabi.org/RAMA%20TIRTHA%20SVAMI%20(1873-1906).html
Sannyasa Diwali 1899; Madhava Tirtha; Kirti Shah of Tehri; USA 1902-1904; Bhagat Singh, Bismil -> https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Rama_Tirtha
Married at about ten; two children; Forman Christian College; Oriental College; Sanatana Dharma Sabha; quote 'Tune yourself in love with your country and people' -> https://www.dlshq.org/?p=1876
Sannyasi 1900; died in Ganga at Tehri; Iqbal dirge; quotes 'Poverty is blessed' and 'Vedanta printed in books...' -> https://tribuneindia.com/2000/20001104/windows/main2.htm
Puran Singh met Rama in Tokyo Sept 1902; Shasta Springs; 'All that thou seest, that thou art'; preface 1909 -> https://ramatirtha.org/vol1/preface.htm
Vivekananda Lahore lectures 9 and 12 Nov 1897; gold watch anecdote -> https://www.esamskriti.com/e/History/Great-Indian-Leaders/Swami-Vivekananda-in-Punjab-1.aspx
At home in Persian, Urdu, Hindi, Sanskrit, English; lecture in Persian at a mosque in Egypt -> https://ramatirtha.org/rama.htm
sarvapriyananda: Biswarup Mitra, b. 1971 Kolkata; XIMB MBA; joined 1994; sannyasa 2004 at Belur; roles; Dec 2015 LA; NY 2017; Nagral Fellow 2019-20; Anthropic 2026; AI quote -> https://www.globalindian.com/story/cover-story/swami-sarvapriyananda-vedanta-ai-ethics-anthropic/
Harvard residency, Nagral gift, Clooney class, pilot quote -> https://news.harvard.edu/gazette/story/2019/11/hindu-monastics-expand-their-views-at-harvard-divinity-school/
Books list; Big Think episode; succeeded Tathagatananda -> https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Swami_Sarvapriyananda
TEDx, SAND, Google; dialogues with Spira, Archer, Chalmers, Harris; 'extremely popular globally' -> https://www.eomega.org/people/swami-sarvapriyananda
